internal.title: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 12:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high latency in the ad service was triggered. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion as the root cause, with CPU utilization reaching 98%, exceeding the threshold of 90%. A mitigation action was taken by disabling the adHighCpu flag at 12:20 UTC, which led to a verified recovery with latency metrics returning to normal levels. The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact observed.

Key timeline:
- 12:00 Alert received
- 12:20 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion
- 12:20 Flag disabled to mitigate issue
- 12:20 Recovery verified

No memory leaks or dependency issues were found during the investigation.
